_: Small fixes to the painted sheets, applied by import-spell-art.py after its checks (docs/notes/spell-art-bde.md): `frames` packs a row's source frames (from 0) in this order. (AURAS-BLENDER: the four fixes to the painted area auras, the healing mist's two, the mana font's and Spirit Guardians' ground, are gone with their paintings: those are rendered in Blender now, each a clean loop, by tools/blender-fx/auras/area.py.)

quivering-palm.cast.why: the gathering light ends at its brightest: it fades out over two more frames

tentacles.cast.why: the tentacle ends risen at full: it sinks away (fades) over two more frames
